title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Demo
notes: Played for 18 min through Highball. maintains a solid 50-60 fps on base M1. (made it to the first boss and got my ass kicked several times lol) DualSense didn't work off the bat and with further research, seems to be an issue on Linux as well so it points to something being lost in translation via WINE for their D-input component. Workaround is to use an X-input controller like an 8BitDo Lite (what I used) https://steamcommunity.com/app/4231820/discussions/0/590691034935252178/ other than this, the demo is promising even though I'm more of an ole skool Castlevania kinda guy.. 🦇

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Demo
